candidates.old:
STX ck_kind
    LDA b_ptr
    STA &C0
    LDA b_ptr + 1
    STA &C1
    LDA ck_draw_lo,X
    STA compiled_vec
    LDA ck_draw_hi,X
    STA compiled_vec + 1
    LDA ck_bank,X
    BEQ in_hazel                    \ bank 0: HAZEL, paged in through play
    LDX #&84                        \ ANDY and bank 4 again after
    JSR compiled_call
    BCS unsafe                      \ the banked kinds (the commoner) fall through
.called                             \ carry clear here from either path
    LDY #8                          \ its entry
    LDA #&FF
    STA (v_ptr),Y
    INY
    LDA ck_kind
    STA (v_ptr),Y
candidates.new:
LDY #8                          \ its entry, written now (X = the kind; the kinds never touch
    LDA #&FF                        \ the save block, and a refused part's generic path writes
    STA (v_ptr),Y                   \ these two bytes again before restore_block can read them)
    INY
    TXA
    STA (v_ptr),Y
    LDA b_ptr
    STA &C0
    LDA b_ptr + 1
    STA &C1
    LDA ck_draw_lo,X
    STA compiled_vec
    LDA ck_draw_hi,X
    STA compiled_vec + 1
    LDA ck_bank,X
    BEQ in_hazel                    \ bank 0: HAZEL, paged in through play
    LDX #&84                        \ ANDY and bank 4 again after
    JSR compiled_call
    BCS unsafe                      \ the banked kinds (the commoner) fall through
.called                             \ carry clear here from either path
candidates.summary: compiled_part: the save block's entry (&FF, then the kind) is written before the call while X still holds the kind, so ck_kind (STX and the later LDA) goes: TXA replaces the reload. The writes use only A and Y, which nothing between needs.
candidates.equivalence: Old: kind in X, STX ck_kind, ..., call, then LDY#8/LDA#&FF/STA (v_ptr),Y/INY/LDA ck_kind/STA (v_ptr),Y. New does the same two stores first (A = &FF, then A = X = the kind; Y = 8, 9) and drops ck_kind: its only readers in src are these two lines (grep), and zero page &6C is not read elsewhere through that name. On the drawn path (carry clear) the block ends up identical; Y is dead at .called (LDA v_ptr follows; LDY #1 is reloaded later), A is reloaded, and C and v_ptr are untouched by LDY/LDA/STA/INY/TXA, so ADC #11 still sees C = 0 (the kind's returned carry). The kinds and compiled_call write only PLAYER_SAVE (below the arena), the screen via (&C2) and &C2/&C3, never v_ptr or the arena, and ACCCON is the same before and after the call, so the stores hit the same bytes. On the refused path (carry set, rare: 1906 BCS unsafe never taken in the profile, 1908 runs 2.25 a pass) v_ptr is unchanged and the two bytes at v_ptr + 8/9 are dirty: they are inside the block the drawn path would have filled (11 bytes) so within the reserved room, and the generic path writes v_ptr + 8 (count - 1) and + 9 (address low) for its first non-empty column before restore_block, which walks only from the block start to rb_end, can read them; bytes past rb_end were arbitrary stale arena data before as well. BMI compiled_none exits before the new stores, as before it exited before STX.
candidates.relies_on: Page crossings (listing of build/strykers.lst, 2026-10-22): code before the call grows by 8 bytes, after .called shrinks by 11, net -3 for everything after. BEQ in_hazel (9CFC, target 9D26) currently crosses a page when taken (4 cycles, 0.75 a pass by the measured 6.0 = 1.5*2 + 0.75*4); after the change it is at 9D04 with the target 9D23, same page: 3 cycles, a further 0.75 cycles a pass saved. BCC on_page (9D16 -> 9D1B now) moves to 9D13 -> 9D18, same page. BMI compiled_none and BCS compiled_none are before the change and do not move; BCS unsafe is not taken. JSR compiled_call crossing the 9D00 line costs nothing. Everything after .called shifts down 3: its branches are all within a few bytes and no table read moves; ck_kind (zp &6C) becomes unused but stays declared (no data moves). Also relies on the SKY_HELI=0 kind cache (kc_part) not reading v_ptr + 8/9 before writing them: it is entered only after compiled_part returns carry set, like the generic path.
